tools.summary: Read-only local coordination surface reporting WK-to-integration promote-check facts and fail-closed blockers.
tools.notes: Read-only local coordination route (free_local, no key required) that reports promote-check facts and fail-closed local blockers for one WK/unit relative to its integration/IN-XXXX branch. It accepts only server-resolved repo selection plus a canonical WK id or tracker-local unit id, and it observes coordination facts only. It is not policy authority and does not authorize promotion, merge, rebase, worktree cleanup, lifecycle/status changes, ref updates, or review-policy satisfaction; unknown live refs, candidate identity, liveness, quiescence, lease, touched paths, detached workspace, evidence binding, and branch binding all fail closed. Introduced under IN-0021 by WK-1444 (design/contract) and WK-1445 (metadata split); see the project documentation for the coordination contract and packages/wiki-mcp/src/lib/integration-promote-check-tools.mjs plus packages/wiki-mcp/src/server.mjs for the registered implementation.
